howItWorks.page.title: How it works
howItWorks.page.subtitle: Giving a stake in French startups has never been easier. Discover our simple 5-step process.
howItWorks.steps.0.title: Select
howItWorks.steps.0.description: Pick the investment style that fits you: high-growth start-ups, real-estate crowdfunding, commodities, crypto assets or diversified ETFs. We show you the risk rating, recommended holding period and sample returns so you can decide with full transparency.
howItWorks.steps.1.title: Personalize
howItWorks.steps.1.description: Set your entry ticket (€50, €100, €200 or €500), add a gift note if you like and choose the delivery language. The platform instantly shows the split and any fees, then issues your personalised coupon or portfolio.
howItWorks.steps.2.title: Activate
howItWorks.steps.2.description: Complete identity verification (KYC) and pay by secure card or bank transfer. As soon as payment is confirmed, your investment is activated: you get a confirmation email, access to “My Space” and real-time tracking of your holdings.
howItWorks.steps.3.title: Earn
howItWorks.steps.3.description: Throughout the recommended holding period, you monitor performance from your dashboard. When an exit occurs — equity buy-back, real-estate pay-out, IPO or acquisition — the net proceeds are paid straight to your bank account or crypto wallet. You’re free to reinvest or simply enjoy your gains!
howItWorks.steps.4.title: Cash Out
howItWorks.steps.4.description: When you're ready to access your gains, request a withdrawal directly from your dashboard. Whether through an exit event or after the recommended holding period, transfer your returns securely to your bank account or crypto wallet. The process is simple, transparent, and you remain in full control of your funds at all times.

risk.privateEquity:
Important Risk Warning
Risk level : 6 / 7 (Private Equity)
Private-equity investments carry a high risk of capital loss.
Your capital is not guaranteed and may fall significantly in value.
Recommended holding period : at least five to ten years.
Low liquidity : early resale is often impossible or may incur a heavy discount.
Past performance is not a guide to future returns.
risk.crypto:
Important Risk Warning
Risk level : 7 / 7 (Crypto Assets)
Crypto assets are extremely volatile and exposed to technological, regulatory and market risks.
Your entire capital may be lost.
Recommended horizon : very long-term or purely speculative.
Liquidity varies and operational risks exist (hacking, platform failure).
Past performance is not a guide to future returns.
risk.realEstate:
Important Risk Warning
Risk level : 5 / 7 (Real-Estate Crowdfunding)
Real-estate crowdfunding involves a risk of partial or total capital loss and illiquidity.
Recommended horizon : three to seven years.
Liquidity is limited; repayments depend on project success.
Past performance is not a guide to future returns.
risk.ventureCapital:
Important Risk Warning
Risk level : 7 / 7 (Venture Capital)
Venture-capital investments entail a very high risk of capital loss; most companies may never generate liquidity.
Recommended horizon : at least seven to twelve years.
Complete illiquidity until exit (sale or IPO).
Past performance is not a guide to future returns.
risk.commodities:
Important Risk Warning
Risk level : 5 / 7 (Commodities)
Commodity investments are volatile and influenced by geopolitical and climatic factors; capital values can fluctuate sharply.
Recommended horizon : medium to long term (≥ 5 years).
Liquidity varies by instrument (futures, ETCs, funds, etc.).
Past performance is not a guide to future returns.
risk.etf:
Important Risk Warning
Risk level : 3 / 7 (Diversified ETFs)
Even ETFs that track broad indices remain subject to equity and bond-market swings; the value of your capital may fall.
Recommended horizon : medium to long term (≥ 5 years).
Liquidity is generally high, but prices can be volatile in the short term.
Past performance is not a guide to future returns.

faq.general.title: General
faq.general.q1.a: Prisma Capital is a platform democratizing venture capital through investment gifts. We let you give shares in vetted French start-ups via €200 physical gift cards.
faq.general.q2.q: How does the gift-card system work?
faq.general.q2.a: You purchase a €200 physical gift card to give. The recipient scans the QR code, completes their investor profile and chooses the sector to invest in from our diversified portfolios.
faq.general.q3.a: Yes, all our activities are supervised by the AMF (Autorité des Marchés Financiers) under license FR-2024-15. Our execution partners are licensed crowdfunding advisers.
faq.investments.title: Investments
faq.investments.q1.q: What exactly am I investing in?
faq.investments.q1.a: You invest in diversified portfolios of 5–8 French start-ups per sector (clean-tech, AI, food-tech, etc.). Each company is vetted by our due‑diligence team and AMF partners.
faq.investments.q2.a: Investing in start-ups carries a risk of total capital loss. Companies may fail and investments are illiquid (hard to resell). Never invest more than you can afford to lose.
faq.investments.q3.q: When can I get my money back?
faq.investments.q3.a: Venture investments are typically illiquid for 3–7 years. An exit may occur if the company is acquired or goes public. No return is guaranteed.
faq.investments.q4.a: Yes, our mobile app lets you track your portfolio, receive company updates and access educational investment content.
faq.practical.title: Practical Aspects
faq.practical.q1.q: Can a minor receive a gift card?
faq.practical.q1.a: Yes, but activation requires consent from a parent or legal guardian who must complete KYC and co-sign the investment.
faq.practical.q2.a: No. The €200 price includes everything: the investment, management fees, the physical card and shipping. No extra fees are charged during the investment term.
faq.practical.q3.q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.practical.q3.a: You have 14 days to cancel your purchase before the card is activated. Once the investment is activated and executed, no refund is possible as the funds are invested in the companies.
faq.practical.q4.a: Our analysts evaluate each company on strict criteria: founding team, commercial traction, market potential and impact on the French economy. Only 5% of applications are accepted.
faq.legal.title: Tax & Legal
faq.legal.q1.a: Capital gains from the sale of shares are subject to capital‑gains tax. However, schemes like the PEA-PME may apply. Consult a tax advisor.
faq.legal.q2.a: The gift-card recipient becomes the owner of the shares upon acquisition. For minors, a custodial account is opened with the parent/guardian as agent until majority.
faq.legal.q3.q: What happens if Prisma Capital closes?
faq.legal.q3.a: Your investments are held by our licensed custodian partner independent of Prisma Capital. If we close, another licensed manager would take over to ensure continuity.
